data.name: Ghaisan
data.gender_notes: Ghaisan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'ghayth' which means gentle, kind, and compassionate. This name is also mentioned in the Quran as the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). The name Ghaisan carries the meaning “Gentle, Kind” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Ghaisan usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, kind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle and compassionate nature of Allah (swt) towards His creation. It serves as a reminder to be kind and compassionate to others.
data.etymology: Ghaisan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Kind.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ghaisan total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
